sound.title: Viral sound / your track
sound.importHint: An MP3/M4A/WAV, or a TikTok, Reel or Short you saved — we take its soundtrack. It is analysed in your browser and never uploaded.
sound.ready: Sound ready — cuts synced to the beat and the drop
sound.missing: "{{name}}" is not loaded any more — import it again to hear it.
sound.sync: Sync the edit to the sound
sound.syncHint: Starts the sound so the drop lands on the first cut, moves every cut onto the beat and punches in on each bar after the drop.
sound.hookHint: A big line at the top for the first seconds — the hook decides whether people keep watching. Keep it out of the bottom third, where TikTok puts its own caption.
sound.warnBody: "{{name}}" is marked as a viral sound. Trending sounds often contain music owned by labels or other creators, and TikTok's terms do not allow business accounts to use other users' original sounds. The platform can mute the video, take it down or reduce its reach. You are responsible for the rights to what you publish.
sound.warnTip: Tip: for the most reach, export without music and pick the same sound inside TikTok/Instagram — the cut is already timed to it, and your video appears on the sound's page.

studio.hudOn: Marc de seguretat, creus i codi de temps sobre la imatge

tiktok.title: TikTok sound (by link)
tiktok.placeholder: Paste a TikTok sound or video link
tiktok.invalid: That is not a TikTok link.
tiktok.tapStart: Mark the beat: press, then play the sound
tiktok.tapHint: Play the sound on your phone as you press. Tap along with the beat and hit “Drop” when it kicks in. No file needed — the video is cut to your taps.
tiktok.apply: Cut the video to this sound
tiktok.howTo: In TikTok: tap “Add sound”, pick this sound, and trim it to start at {{start}} — the cuts land on its beat ({{bpm}} BPM).
tiktok.captureTab: Capture it from a TikTok tab (computer)
tiktok.captureHint: Tab: open the link in another tab, press here, pick that tab with “Share tab audio” on, press play there and stop when it has played. We get the real sound, find the beat and the drop, and cut the video to it. Microphone: play it on your phone next to the device — used only for timing.
tiktok.recordingTab: Recording the tab… press play on the sound
tiktok.recordingMic: Listening… play the sound near the microphone
tiktok.noTabAudio: No audio came through. Share a browser TAB and turn on “Share tab audio”.
